view_title: CDK2–DOC1 · HDBSCAN leaf · collaborator AF3 cohort

pose_states.protocol: CDK2-aligned DOC1 core placement; ≤10 Å RMSD, ≥0.1 contact overlap, ≥10 contact pairs
pose_states.sampling_note: One supported state; MCMC/DISCO withheld under the no-forced-second-state rule.

bonsai.method: Native Bonsai on one lowest-ProteinEBM-energy model per assigned cluster plus up to five explicit low-energy unassigned examples; extra next-lowest-energy cluster members reach eleven leaves where needed; full-construct accepted 4096-dimensional all-pair sketch; all nonzero PCA axes; no whitening or variance scaling.

representative_policy: One lowest-energy accepted model per assigned cluster; select a point to inspect that exact model. Source class is a supplied annotation, not a cluster label.
mask_note: Full construct A1–298 + B1–115; all residues retained; 910 models fit and displayed.
clustering_method_note: Accepted full-construct 4,096-D all-pair sketch; 2-D/10-D UMAP, UMAP KNN and 10-D HDBSCAN (leaf/EOM), seed 42. ProteinEBM energies are color overlays, not fit features. Bonsai and TM use lowest-energy cluster representatives. Click a point to inspect its exact native structure.

medoid_tm.title: TM similarity across energy-selected cluster representatives
medoid_tm.note: Fixed-chain whole-construct bidirectional US-align TM. Heatmap cells are representative comparisons; select a cell to inspect the corresponding coordinate pair.

provenance.coordinate_policy: Exact native coordinate bytes with verified atlas chain mapping.
